title: centaurea × duffortii
intro: Centaurea × duffortii, commonly known as Cornflower, is a hybrid flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. The health benefits of Cornflower include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe skin irritations, and act as a natural antiseptic. Therapeutically, Cornflower has been used to treat various conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems, due to its calming and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Cornflower include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
